text: Godiva, also called Godgifu or Dame Goode Eve, is a British heroine. In 1967 Coventry marked the reputed 900th year of her death. Medieval chronicles praise her generosity with her husband Leofric, earl of Mercia. The chronicles also record her famous ride. She rode naked through Coventry, clothed only in her hair, to protest taxes that threatened the vassals with starvation. Scholars read her as a disguise for an ancient goddess protector. Her ride recalls the horse goddess and old fertility rites.

okr.objective: Present Godiva as a British heroine whose ride veils an ancient goddess protector.
